module: "Sites" class: container of a *.sites.json file. Groups three sorted lists (locations, zones, parkingSpots), tag indexes and spatial trees (kd-trees) for position queries. The module returns a constructor; it is usually obtained via gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites. After loading, finalizeSites() computes the zone/location/spot links and the indexes.
usage:
local sites = gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites(path)
local list = sites:getRadialParkingSpots(pos, 0, 50)
for _, e in ipairs(list) do print(e.ps.name, math.sqrt(e.squaredDistance)) end
notes: The _uid identifier counter is local to the module and shared by all sites objects: identifiers are globally unique, not per file.
onDeserialized clears locations and zones but not parkingSpots before reloading.
Radial queries work in 2D (z ignored); the returned distances are squared.
Spatial queries (getRadial*, getClosestParkingSpot, getZonesForPosition) only work after finalizeSites().

C.desc: Sites object. Fields: name, description, id, locations / zones / parkingSpots (gameplay/util/sortedList, with .sorted and .objects), tags, sortedTags, tagsToZones, tagsToLocations, quadtreeLocations, quadtreeZones, quadtreeParkingSpots, dir, filename.

getNextUniqueIdentifier.desc: Increments and returns the global counter of sites object identifiers.

init.desc: Constructor: creates the three sorted lists and a default name "Sites".

drawDebug.desc: Draws all locations, zones and parking spots in debug.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes name, description, the three lists, dir and filename.

onDeserialized.desc: Reloads the sites set from a serialized table (literal "\n" in the description become real line breaks).

oldIdMap.desc: Old id -> new id mapping, filled by the lists.

finalizeSites.desc: To call after loading. Generates multiple spots, sorts, builds the name and tag indexes, attaches locations and spots to the zones that contain them (2D test) and builds the kd-trees.

getRadialLocations.desc: Lists the locations whose 2D distance to pos is between minRadius and maxRadius.

getRadialParkingSpots.desc: Lists the parking spots whose 2D distance to pos is between minRadius and maxRadius.

getClosestParkingSpot.desc: Parking spot closest to pos (3D kd-tree).

returns.desc: Distance returned by the kd-tree's findNearest.

zonesForPositionIterator.desc: Generic iterator over the zones containing pos, to use in a for: for id, zone in sites:zonesForPositionIterator(pos) do. Avoids allocating a table; ctx can be reused.

getTagsForZonesAtPosition.desc: Gathers the tags of all zones that contain pos.
